subject: Pre-week lead huddle: sales readouts & account notes for QBR
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pre-week lead huddle: sales readouts & account notes for QBR

Team —

Quick kick-off for the week: we need a tight, one-page readout per top-12 account to feed into the QBR packet by EOD Thursday. Focus areas: current forecast, delta from last forecast, showstoppers, and an explicit ask (commitment level / PO timing / legal blockers).

Please treat Apex Health (APX) as a priority — procurement asked for updated exec summary this week and we should have a clear ask around signing window.

Action items:
- Marissa: can you assemble the one-pager for APX and attach any supporting forecast deltas?
- Karthik: own the velocity callout and the risk mitigation bullets (3 max).
- Tessa: I'll synthesize these into the leadership sheet and pull the consolidated forecast.

Also, flag any accounts where we should propose a short-term credit or pilot extension for runway. Keep language crisp — leadership wants concise talking points.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

On Mon, Jun 7, 2027 at 9:12 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
>
> Quick kick-off for the week...

Attached: Account-Snapshots-APX.pdf (summary one-pager) and APX-forecast-deltas.xlsx (raw numbers). Highlights from my side:

- Current quarter: $420k committed ARR; forecast consensus at $520k if PO arrives by July 1.
- Delta vs prior: +$80k upside from expected add-ons (embed usage) but timing risk — procurement requested an internal security checklist before final sign.
- Showstoppers: SOC 2 attestation copy and a tighter data-retention clause requested by their legal.
- Ask: We should request a soft verbal commitment this week and lock a PO date. If procurement needs more, offer a short 30-day pilot price hold.

I'll be on the call with APX on Wednesday; will push for a firm PO date and capture any redlines.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole

Thanks — quick add from velocity lens:

- Conversion velocity: legal loop historically ~18 business days for APX; procurement currently at 11 days in queue. If we accelerate, likely PO within 2 weeks.
- Risk items (3): (1) SOC 2 evidence delivery timeline; (2) data-retention clause language — need constraints on log TTL; (3) renewal term language (APX prefers annual with auto-renew).

Recommended mitigations:
1) Offer SOC 2 readout + pointer to our audit summary (I can draft the one-paragraph snippet).
2) Propose a clean, customer-friendly data-retention clause with an opt-in audit window (legal can template).
3) For exec signaling, suggest offering a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of first-year committed spend if PO signed by July 15.

I'll be ready to provide the velocity bullet for the leadership sheet.

Karthik
Sr. Sales Manager — West
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Jonas —

Thanks for the one-pager and the clear ask. Quick update from procurement: we have the contract in the review queue and expect to return a clean PO request by 2027-06-21 if there are no new legal changes. Our legal is reviewing the data-retention clause; if Redwood can share the standard template (or a proposed tweak) by EOD Tuesday that will help speed things. SOC 2 attestation is available; I can share a read-only copy with your team this afternoon.

Regarding the onboarding credit, I will escalate to my manager as part of the budget alignment conversation — that could help get internal approval faster.

I'll send the PO contact and an internal timeline in a follow-up.

Best,
Morgan Lee
Head of Digital Platforms
Apex Health

Nice — thanks for the quick turn, Morgan (cc internal).

Internal recap / next steps for leadership packet:
- Tessa: include Marissa's APX one-pager in the leadership slide deck under "Top Priority Accounts" and call out the PO target date (2027-06-21) and the mitigation (onboarding credit option).
- Marissa: please share SOC 2 stub when Morgan sends it; I'll route to security for an OK-to-share note.
- Karthik: draft the 1-paragraph SOC 2 readout + the suggested data-retention clause; we'll slot those under "Risk & Mitigation."

If we hit the PO target, APX moves from Commit to Commit+ in the QBR forecast. I will lock the consolidated number after your inputs and circulate the final packet by Thursday morning.

Thanks everyone — tight and focused.

Jonas
